summary: Katapult Holdings filed an 8-K regarding the Third Amendment and Limited Waiver to its Amended and Restated Loan and Security Agreement. The amendment removes the Minimum Trailing Net Three-Month Originations covenant and reduces the advance rate. The filing details a series of prior waivers and amendments, indicating ongoing financial strain. No deal price or premium is involved; the amendment modifies existing credit terms with lenders including Midtown Madison Management LLC. The structural note involves waivers of financial covenants and reduced borrowing capacity. What to watch: further covenant modifications or potential default triggers under the revised advance rate and liquidity conditions.
